svg.text: Without a Tongue: where the machine's taste is not the people's
48 of 67 foods. Blue: 12 instances rating. Orange: 59 people. Green (above the line): 6 instances describing the people. Medians, 1–9 scale.
Data: Galgani 2026, Zenodo 23296649 (CC BY 4.0); machine replies in this experiment's rooms/.
